prep.summary:
Completed logging/scheduler cleanup and billing/payment fixes. Structured logging and safe `request_id` handling are in place; billing session rollback, invoice pagination, and payment failure logging preserve expected errors. Scheduler recurrence now combines local scheduled date/time with the configured IANA timezone before UTC conversion, fixing DST wall-clock behavior. Scheduler, billing, payment, health, and focused regression tests pass; Ruff and whitespace checks are clean. Full suite: 186 passed, 2 skipped, 1 unrelated failure in the legacy `test_rounding_legacy_currency` fixture (1000 vs. 1001 after `ROUND_HALF_UP` quantization).

Tax handling has not yet been verified and remains future work, along with session-factory lifecycle/commit tracing, payment retry/webhook ordering, and structured worker retry reasons. S3 archival and invoice numbering are complete.

Rounding behavior was investigated in `billing/currency.py`, with twelve invoice call sites. Added and ran `tests/test_currency_rounding.py`: all five initial parameterized cases passed, covering half-cent, 1.5-cent, and negative values. Added zero/small-input coverage; `$0.00` remains stable and values below half a cent round down. Current working-tree changes include the scheduler recurrence fix, two focused scheduler regression tests, and the new currency-rounding tests. Release branch: `release/2026.47`.
